concepts.name: Derivative
concepts.simple_definition: The derivative measures the instantaneous rate of change of a function, representing the slope of the tangent line.
concepts.deep_explanation: Mathematically, f'(x) = lim (h->0) [f(x+h) - f(x)] / h. Rules like Power Rule, Product Rule, and Chain Rule are used for fast computation.
concepts.real_example: The derivative of f(x) = x² is f'(x) = 2x, representing the slope at any point x.
concepts.common_confusion: Thinking a function is differentiable everywhere. Functions are not differentiable at sharp corners, vertical tangents, or discontinuities.
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: ዲሪቬቲቭ ማለት የአንድ ፈንክሽን ቅጽበታዊ የለውጥ መጠን ሲሆን፣ የታንጀንት መስመሩን ስሎፕ ይወክላል።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: የዲሪቬቲቭ ቀመር f'(x) = lim (h->0) [f(x+h) - f(x)] / h ነው። እንደ ፖወር ሩል ያሉ ደንቦችን በመጠቀም በቀላሉ ይሰላል።
concepts.real_example_amharic: የ f(x) = x² ዲሪቬቲቭ f'(x) = 2x ነው፣ ይህም በማንኛውም የ x እሴት ላይ ያለውን ስሎፕ ያሳያል።
concepts.common_confusion_amharic: ፈንክሽን በሁሉም ነጥብ ላይ ዲሪቬቲቭ አለው ብሎ ማሰብ። በሹል ማዕዘኖች ላይ ዲሪቬቲቭ የለውም።
